shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure in columnar/monolithic form
head with rendered facial features (brow, eyes, mouth) at top
torso below head with low-relief incised motifs
shallow linear/incised surface decoration over the body
arms/limbs indicated in low relief against the body
justification: Both depict a schematic frontal anthropomorph in columnar form, with a broad heavy-browed head at the top, a torso beneath carrying shallow incised/low-relief ornament including hatched and curvilinear elements, and limbs rendered flat against the body rather than free-standing. The clearest difference in content is that A's face is modelled with plastic eyes, nose and open mouth and its body ornament is a net-like hatched banding, whereas B's face is reduced to a browridge with barely-marked features and its body carries discrete round/ring and looping emblem-like devices arranged as separate symbols.
